title: Fly Brains Fly a Plane
subtitle: A real fruit-fly connectome at the controls of a FlightGear airliner
rule: The connectome is the controller. Encoders and decoders stay thin; we never train the wiring with backprop, and every result is compared with a dumb baseline.

goals.name: Takeoff fly
goals.text: One fly brain gets the plane off the runway.

goals.name: Three flies
goals.text: Takeoff, Cruise and Landing flies, each owning one phase of flight.

goals.name: Barrel roll + dopamine
goals.text: A barrel roll, and learning through the fly's own PAM / PPL1 dopamine neurons.

pipeline.name: Decoder
pipeline.text: neuron rates to stick, rudder, throttle

pipeline.name: Controls
pipeline.text: back into the sim, paused per trial

next_steps: Run the connectome takeoff with the pause fix and capture it start to finish
Name the cockpit hotspots and feed their directions to the fly's visual inputs
Cruise fly: obstacle avoidance on the 737 with the live 3D fly body
Landing fly; dopamine learning is owned by a teammate (not this team's scope)
